svg.title: India blank outline map with state and union territory boundaries
svg.desc: Generalised state and union territory boundaries for Class 10 map-skill practice. Derived from OpenStreetMap data through Vardhan Systems vardhan-maps and simplified for compact rendering. Not an official Survey of India map; not for legal or boundary determination.
svg.metadata: Boundary source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via Vardhan Systems vardhan-maps states.low.json, generated 2026-09-08. OpenStreetMap data available under ODbL. Generalised educational map, not official or survey-grade.
svg.text: INDIA · BLANK MAP PRACTICE · STATE/UT OUTLINES
